text:
Situation: Pantoprazole sodium has been on FDA's shortage list since 2019-05-28 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a span of 89 months. Hospital inventory shows 13.6 to 22.1 days on hand across sites and presentations.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1066512 at Pharmacia & Upjohn Company LLC (FEI 1810189) ended 2018-09-21 with a VAI classification, 249 days before the shortage posting on 2019-05-28. The same plant was most recently inspected in 2023-06-16 and again classified VAI. Another labeled supplier, Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407), received an OAI classification in 2009-06-11 and a Warning Letter on 2010-04-08, but its later inspections have been VAI, most recently 2026-07-16.

Our position: Current stock provides limited coverage. Multiple alternative suppliers are not on FDA's shortage list today, though their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and purchase from Avenacy, LLC; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate and purchase from BE Pharmaceuticals Inc.; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate and purchase from Baxter Healthcare Company; requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate and purchase from Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc.; requires P&T committee approval.
5. Buyer to evaluate and purchase from Civica, Inc.; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: No changes to clinical protocols or dosing at this time.
